points.point: Where to connect Google Business Profile
points.sentence: Blotato does not support Google Business Profile.

To send post content to another destination like Google Business Profile, use the webhook publish target with an automation tool (n8n, Make.com, or Zapier): Blotato sends the post data to your webhook, and your automation posts it to the destination.

verdict.reason: The entry states Google Business Profile isn't supported, so there's nowhere to connect it, and it gives the webhook workaround for sending posts there.
